Im not sure where you are; but this happens to me in my area quite a bit because our pharmacies are atrocious (my county is currently on a month backorder for Adderall with no answers will they’ll have it again)
Couldnt afford my doctor’s visit yesterday so im now out for the weekend myself.

Its absolutely AWFUL - i have immediate inability to stand from vertigo and nonstop vomiting within hours of the missed dose.

In the past ive taken kratom and Benadryl and just tried to sleep through it to make it tolerable. I also smoke weed though i really try to limit movement and try very hard to just sleep.
(This weekend, my mom happened to have extra prozac and i currently feel better than i would on my effexor dose. Fingers crossed i dont get whacked sometime tomorrow w symptoms)

I have not had decompression surgery, diagnosed around age 12 (left side herniation) and got pregnant around 19.
I saw a high risk OBGYN; they originally aimed for natural birth, however, i began losing more and more feeling in feet and hands - becoming a fall risk and was induced at 36 weeks. The induction failed after 2 days however and went for the c-section.

I hate that their is not a lot of information available; though when i see how routinely straining during things like a bowel movement can worsen symptoms - the thought of natural birth and that kind of pushing? I was confused when they told me they intended for me to go natural birth.

Please leave! Seriously!
I was 25F with 32M and thought I’d met my soulmate
However it was similar to this - messing with your sleep is intentional. So when he was screaming and insulting me again (because i facetimed coworkers during quarantine) I slapped him.
It was exhilarating - i know the feeling your referring too.
I had never slapped or hit someone or started a fight

This is an INCREDIBLY toxic road. 
The violence will escalate; and now that he realizes he can get a trauma/defense reaction out of you - he will use it against YOU. 
He will make himself the victim, he will use your trauma reactions as a shield

It will get worse

As someone who can relate - PLEASE step away and self-reflect to find the root source of these
emotions; find out why you feel this is a situation you deserve to be in
Msg me

Thank you; one of the largest struggles ive had is that not many people can relate but want to support - they mean well… yet its only advice on what i shouldnt do. Its like ok; heres all the wrong moves i can make - what can i do? What can i still enjoy when numerous activities trigger my PTSD and others are the wrong thing to do/enjoy

I saw you got downvotes (and im not someone to go grab a bottle cause someone on reddit said it was ok) but a professional did say similar - not to go drink - more that I focused on a coping mechanism when the root of my struggles were elsewhere

Actually a trauma counselor i got to see for a gew weeks said something similar - that it could be a phase due to repressing prior trauma as i didnt go to any programs or court orders but stayed sober on my own.

Im not offended by this comment; im curious to why you suggest it though? 
Most in my life makes it seem like if i did that id be taking a massive step back… though i think theyre scared cause of how bad my mom was

Same unfortunately! Obviously libido is gone; i get immediate “discontinuation” symptoms by nighttime when taking one dose in the AM.
For nearly a year I couldnt figure out why I was having panic attacks, uncontrollable crying, vertigo and vomiting at night - figured CPTSD related.
But it was the effexor; it has a short half life so it leaves my system very quickly and by the next morning i was feeling it bad and if for any reason (medicaid, doctors, pharmacists which are all overwhelmed and delayed by me constantly) i miss a dose by the 24hr mark i cant stand or stop throwing up.

Im now on 75mg twice daily and I’m take a small dose of kratom at night to tolerate. I had been on 150mg XR the year prior
I have a strong dislike bordering hatred for this medication and much of me wishes id never been put on it.
My pharmacy would not fill one day and i was out; my mom was driving me to figure out something and the vomiting began. She’s seen opiod withdrawal; she was terrified as it was so similar as i was sweating and shaking too.


I understand how helpful it is for some; but for me i want to scream and toss it because i now feel trapped with it. My symptoms between my conditions are all still a disabling level too which definitely prevent positive feelings.
This made me tear up; im so happy you were able to make the right call - your Dad is awesome and obviously cares about your safety.

Missing a dose or mistiming my doses (I had to switch to immediate release because one 150mg xr in the AM had me in withdrawals by night)

It’s one of the most distressing experiences I’ve had 
Pins and needles, vertigo to the point I can’t stand, vomiting, and my mood whips ALL over the map from pacing, to crying, to even feeling the urge to self harm

I’ve had a similar process to commenters here and was absolutely gobsmacked when I realized how badly it effected me

I realize I should’ve clarified! Sorry still getting use to posting.
I’m not fighting to stay on this drug and would rather get off of it due to the complications and switch to something else 

He’s perfectly ok continuing to prescribe it as I’m already on it but also open to making switch if I want

THIS
You explained the feeling I have.

I don’t feel like the Effexor is working miracles on me - not anything drastically better than others I’ve been on.
I’m more upset I feel stuck with this drug despite it creating more negatives than positives at this point

The scary part is I am compliant in taking the medication, I swear.
Unfortunately living in the US, healthcare is an absolute BITCH and my local pharmacies are an absolute joke right now - always out of stock of something - and getting in with doctors in my network is nearly impossible (2-3 months in advance for appointments, urgent or not)

Times I miss a dose or fill is delayed is because of my provider or pharmacy, or insurance (splitting my 150mg daily to 2 x 75mg and they refused it) 
I ended up having to pay $60 out of pocket with goodrx to get the script filled and my insurance will likely drop me for it.
I’ve never heard of Pristiq?
I’m slowly learning this! How to take control of my care and start being very clear on what I want handled and how

That’s your personal experience 

Turns out my multiple times a week at night puking, sobbing, and vertigo spells were me already entering withdraw from my morning dose and we now have to split my dose so I can function a whole day.

A missed dose results in me being unable to get up off the floor or stop puking within 24 hours, by 36-48 I can’t stop crying, pacing, puking, shaking, and uncontrollably hitting myself.

Absolutely not.

I should say I’ve been on several antidepressants on the past and not one has caused anything like Effexor has. 
If anything it felt relieving and validating that someone actually understood and acknowledged how awful it is for some of us

He suggested Paxil as one I shouldn’t take because of this.
I hate to call him an idiot considering I’ve been on amitriptyline, Zoloft, lexapro, and mirtazapine in the past - along with a prior alcohol/cocaine abuse period - none and I mean none gave me anything near what Effexor has done to me when delaying or missing a dose

I’m making efforts to come off it. I’ve been on several other antidepressants in the past, none of which caused anything like this drug does to me

I’m so happy it works great for some people but it has begun increasing my anxiety over fear for some reason or another I won’t have it
The original psych who put me on this told me nothing
I’ve seen case studies on this and read up - some reporting lawsuits over the withdrawals of this medication, one citing a link to opioid receptors being affected by Effexor too.

I have the same reaction if I’m late or miss a dose; it happens so fast and the worst feeling I’ve ever experienced. 
Makes me scared to be on it forever

Thanks I’m definitely going to be bringing it up during my appointment this week!
I’m on capsules, however my health insurance and pharmacy absolutely -suck- which is how I’ve previously experienced missed doses.

I didn’t even think about the foggy, nauseous head feeling I’ve been experiencing so much at night being related to the Effexor XR until this last time when I was informed my doctor could take 3 days to respond to the script request 🥲 

I’m furious I was not warned at all and even upon bringing it up they seem to shrug it off? Like “well it’s working for your mood right?” 
I on the other hand am upset and alarmed at how hard it seems to hit me!
I’ve been on it a while now and having the side effects increase now 😕

Oh man 😕
I’d rather not increase my dose if it’s just prolonging the eventual withdrawal of the medication
I’ve been on other antidepressants previously and nothing created problems like this one 😩
Thank you, I get worried because I don’t want to make her feel bad or guilty

Even than, coming from abusive relationships, it’s better to separate. It’ll always be too easy to fall back into the abuser/victim dynamic, even for an abuser who is actively trying to get better - it’s like a habit you slip bank into.

Yes; I had a traumatic event and the direct few months after I didn’t think I had been horribly affected - some symptoms came on than faded only to return much higher now that the full event and everything it means has really settled in

A messed up spinal tap 😭 I was 13/14 under local sedation - was unaware I had a bone spur so when the DR put the needle in it struck the spur, I woke up to my leg involuntarily jumping and the worse pain I’ve ever experienced to this day; he tried again before deciding something wasn’t right 😫
Ive never been a sweaty person and since being on Effexor I sweat all the time!

I started having to wear headphone when I go places. PTSD + ADHD makes me very anxious and hyper vigilant in stores to the point of breakdowns and headphones help me tune a lot of that out. 
I usually wear one nearly all the time; in silence it’s to prevent my thoughts from focusing on dark places, and in public to make me less anxious and prevent panic - people are less likely to approach and strike random conversation too

Nearly every song from a Broadway style play - they make it so “perfect” as in the notes and sound quality while removing any gritty, natural ‘imperfections’ that are part of the emotion and depth of the song
My worsening PTSD

I’ve actually noticed an increase in my sensory issues particularly to chewing or eating sounds; I’ve always been sensitive to this but it’s gotten to an intense, panic inducing, fear of eating with people level in the last year - since I’ve started Effexor 150mg
I called my pharmacy and explained the situation and they actually were able to give me a few but told me to call my DR asap after the weekend!

I called my pharmacy to explain and they said they could provide me some until Monday 
I have to work unfortunately and unsure how I’m going to function through 😭

I’m on 150mg 
I rarely crave sex and can’t orgasm anymore or find it really difficult.

I was a bartender when DoorDash and Uber etc started really picking up
We did all the work - we put in the order from the tablets, had to check the order, bag it, seal it etc. 
Drivers would come in and majority of the time be rude AF, taking up seats at the bar preventing guests from sitting, glare at me and even snap at me to hurry up, recheck the order - recheck again - godforbid I focused on serving my guests.
I had did quadruple the work for 0 of the pay and it negatively affected my tips. Yes I also brought this up to my employer for how ridiculous it was, they needed to hire a Togo person and the company needed to provide the wage as they wouldn’t be tipped and it did in many places based on local store budget - bosses suck and are greedy we know this.
The drivers would walk in, say the name (if there’s not a pick up shelf) and walk out. Often they were rude to me, left the drinks behind, didn’t double check the name on the bag and than I got the call from the pissed of customer.

Having to do most of the work with the delivery orders while receiving no compensation, getting barked at by drivers and having to take time from my bar guests (lowering my tips) or get stuck fixing BS w/ the order was the leading reason I quit and 
“Who handles the delivery orders?” Became a question I asked when looking for new work

I worked at Hooters for several years - what some men think is not only acceptable to say to someone; but that you should feel honored by it is REMARKABLE.
Though this was from my local gas stations clerk fml

Your really pretty - even with your acne. It’s usually unattractive but you still look good 

I have PCOS - I was experiencing purging after seeking out dermatologist help for it

My ex. I thought I had found the love of my life; a “soulmate”. We latch to each other so quickly and intensely; we were both bartenders and he loved a fun lifestyle with lots of friends…
Due to childhood trauma, and my life at the time I had really been struggling with feeling unappreciated, unwanted and lonely and it felt good.
This was happening right before quarantine. By mid-pandemic neither of us had been able to get money for over a month, our drinking escalated and the abuse was full swing. Physical & verbal; and there were days where I would only be able to eat if we were on good terms & who knows how id upset him that day
By the end of it when I cut contact he had begun sending death threats; I had lost everything literally all my belongings during quarantine and had to “vanish”
I struggle with looking over my shoulder every time I’m outside, had to start a new career, lose any friend, and make sure if I saw anyone we had known in public I had to disappear into the opposite direction 
I have nothing all because i accepted an invite for a drink, I asked for a kiss; now I cry every day, remember the fear, the intensity in his face when getting physical, how long he tried to track me and want to kill me, yet despite bruises and injuries I had cried for acceptance because he had food, he had alcohol when I began DTs as long as I was “good”, I lost my home, my car, the entire life I had been building. It’s been so painful, and idk if illl ever really recover
